items.title: Edward "Noon" Johnson Interview, 1960-05-28
items.q: then you begin to hear talk of Bob Burns and Ben Crosby.

ctx.x: Was he on radio then already? Was he on radio? I used to hear him on radio when I was younger.

He said, oh you didn't hear no talk of him. He wasn't known then. Wasn't thanks. Or nothing like that until 29. After he saw my horn. And in 1929, in 28, then you begin to hear talk of Bob Burns and Ben Crosby. And he named the horn the bazooka. So after everybody saw me play that, they started calling it bazooka so I wouldn't tell them no better.
So you still call it the bazooka then? It's still called the bazooka.
